role: Preparation evidence and proposed Android assertions, not a DSH execution success record

preparation.tar_metadata_note: Old buffer-equal-constant-time GNU/PAX UID/GID headers trigger .NET TarReader arithmetic overflow. bsdtar copies archives into temporary PAX with UID/GID zero. No archive is filesystem-extracted by bsdtar; file bytes, paths and modes are retained. Original cached archives are never modified and remain checked against npm SHA512 SRI. Only regular file payloads become assets.
preparation.smoke_reproducibility: All 890 path, SHA256, bytes and mode rows matched after tar header normalization.

cli_acceptance.home_behavior: The published bin parses version/help and exits before invoking loadLayeredEnv, resolveDshHome or profile boot. Version reads dsh-app-boot/package.json. Explicit isolated HOME and DSH_HOME should still be supplied. This is not evidence for normal profile startup.
cli_acceptance.missing_file_policy: A missing module or file in these fixtures is a preparation defect to fix, not evidence that Sucrune is incompatible.

native_acceptance.loader_behavior: createEntryApi immediately loads the native binding. requireBuiltin forwards to binding.requireBuiltin and getBindingInfo calls binding.getNativeBindingInfo. The default native cache uses os.tmpdir unless NARB_NATIVE_CACHE_DIR is set. libc classification first reads process.execPath ELF PT_INTERP, then /proc/self/maps, then process.report as a fallback. process.execPath must represent the guest Node executable.

full_profile_native_inputs.additional: bin/landlock-run is a separately shipped static helper; no Landlock availability is claimed.
Linux forkpty path does not use the macOS-only spawn-helper binary. libutil.so.1 must be supplied for full PTY verification.
Depends on libvips-cpp.so.8.18.7 from @img/sharp-libvips-linux-arm64@1.3.4; upstream RPATH references the sibling platform package.
Depends on bundled libsherpa-onnx-c-api.so and libonnxruntime.so using $ORIGIN RPATH, plus system C/C++ libraries. Exact package version and all bytes are pinned in the main provenance.
Official platform package includes the executable; no postinstall download is required.

limits: CLI smoke preserves complete packages in its closure but deliberately excludes profiles and their 626 other packages.
A Full manifest with assets_materialized=false is a recovery index and must not be used as an importable asset directory.
Installing packages with npm inside the phone, profile startup, PTY/processes, Web/HTTP, SQLite/flock, model access and DSH tasks require separate real guest validation.
No upstream JavaScript or native binaries were patched.
